name: Walmart+ Assist
description: Eligible government assistance recipients receive Walmart+ at 50% off ($6.47/mo. or $49/yr.)
fullDescription: Walmart+ is Walmart's membership program offering free delivery, fuel discounts, and more. Walmart+ Assist provides the full membership at half price for people enrolled in qualifying government assistance programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- 50% off Walmart+ membership ($6.47/month or $49/year)
- Free delivery from your local store
- Member prices on fuel
- Choice of Paramount+ or Peacock streaming
- Same benefits as a regular Walmart+ membership
howToGetIt:
1. Visit walmart.com/plus/assist
2. Confirm you are enrolled in a qualifying program such as SNAP, WIC, Medicaid, SSI, TANF, Tribal TANF, the National School Lunch Program, or LIHEAP
3. Complete eligibility verification through Walmart's partner, SheerID
4. Start your discounted membership
keywords: Walmart+, Walmart Plus, Assist, EBT, SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, TANF, WIC, NSLP, LIHEAP, free delivery, fuel discount, membership discount, low-income, grocery delivery
